## Rule

**Generator-decoded 2026-06-06** (`external/ARC-GEN/tasks/task_36fdfd69.py` — the code that
draws the hidden set): the grid is h in [15,20] rows x w = h+-1 cols (**hard max 20x21**,
re-verified over the full 200k corpus cache), covered ~50% by ONE static noise color
(never 2/4). 2..4 boxes (t in {2,3} x w in {2..7}) are drawn with `overlaps(spacing=2)`
separation = **>=2-cell gap in at least one axis** (the other axis may overlap freely);
box cells that held noise become 4 in the OUTPUT (but show as noise in the INPUT); empty
box cells become 2 (in both). A legality loop guarantees every generated box row AND col
carries >=1 two. Consequences used by candidates:
- 2s exist ONLY inside boxes; 4s NEVER in the input; box cells are only {2, static}.
- bbox(2s of a box) == the box exactly; within-box 2s chain at Chebyshev <=2; foreign 2s
  are >=3 apart. So the rule == "Chebyshev<=2-cluster the 2s, fill every non-2 cell of
  each cluster bbox with 4" (cand_cluster_bbox: 200k/200k + 266/266).
- **Hand-made officials violate the row/col guarantee** (generate() skips the legality
  loop when `colors` is passed): officials[0] has a box middle row with no 2s;
  officials[1] has boxes with a no-2s COLUMN (incl. a 2-wide unsupported hole). Across
  all 266 officials: 1 missing row + 4 missing cols total. Any candidate must handle
  these or die at the visible gate.

## Algorithm sketch (packed-row v5runJ candidate, current best)

Same v5runJ rule as the 7,235 rebuild, but carry the flood as 21-bit `UINT32`
row words after a free-input `Einsum('bchw,c,w->bh')` pack. V5 is four
zero-filled vertical row shifts plus bitwise OR; V5j is `(x<<1)&(x>>1)` OR x;
the three horizontal reach steps are bit shifts masked by V5j; between-v is a
one-row vertical sandwich fill. Since original red-2 bits are a subset of the
flooded mask, `BitwiseXor(m, p)` removes them in one row-word tensor before a
single final unpack to the Boolean `Where` condition.

## Algorithm sketch (v1 v5runJ, previous best)

All-U8 static pipeline at the 20x21 generator envelope: Conv ch2-select +
negative-pad crop -> Cast U8 (P) -> V5 = MaxPool[5,1] (col support +-2 rows) ->
V5j = QLinearConv[1,3] w=[1,2,1] y_scale=3 (width-1 hole fill, = b|(a&c)) ->
3x [MaxPool[1,5] + Min vs V5j] (+-2-step row reach; steps <=2 cannot jump the
>=2-wide inter-box gaps) -> between-v QLinearConv[3,1]/y3 -> Greater(reach, P)
-> Pad BOOL -> Where(cond30, onehot4, input) = free output overlay.

### FLOOR PROOF — why <3,000 (and a fortiori <1,500) has no correct static graph (2026-06-06, owner-requested bar)

Stage-by-stage lower bound; every escape priced and killed:

1. **Tail >= 1,320, locked.** The rule passes ~97% of cells through, so the only free
   assembly is the #48 overlay `Where(cond30, oh4, input)` as THE output node: `cond30`
   [1,1,30,30] BOOL = 900 B is unavoidable (same floor element as task224 ~1,700). cond
   must be `paint AND not-2`, and the cheapest construction is a pre-pad [20,21] BOOL
   Greater (420) + Pad(BOOL) (900). All reorderings priced worse: Sub+PadU8+Greater30 =
   2,220; pad-then-compare needs a padded P (+900). Alternative output nodes are dead:
   Max/Add/Sub cannot clear the old color channel (decoder >0 sees 2 hot channels);
   inner-Where chains materialize [1,10,30,30] = 36,000; ScatterND-as-output needs
   [N,3] INT64 indices + [N,10] F32 updates >= 5,376 with N fixed at the worst case;
   a #58b BitwiseAnd bit-expansion output cannot pass through the input (rank-full).
2. **A per-cell 2-read >= 2,100, locked.** ORT keeps the input F32, so the first touch
   of per-cell data costs 4 B/elem: negpad-Conv [1,1,20,21] = 1,680 is the cheapest
   (Slice ch2 30x30 = 3,600; Einsum 'bchw,c->bhw' = 3,600; Cast(input) = 18,000;
   ArgMax(ch) = INT64 7,200; strided phase-convs sum to the same 1,680). +420 U8 cast
   (F16/F32 pipelines double every later plane). The old packed-row escape that started
   from the spatial U8 plane lost, but the free-input packed-row seam was later built at
   **7,161**, then narrowed to **6,524** (Worker W5 2026-06-24). It still pays a locked
   final re-spatialization, but that is NOT a 1,680 U32 plane: the exit bit-TEST needs only
   1 byte/cell, so splitting the 21-bit row word into 3 UINT8 lanes (8/8/5 bits) gives a
   `Concat[1,20,21] BOOL = 420` unpack + 3 sub-AND U8 (420) + 3 Greater BOOL (420) + lane
   extract (300) — never a single 1,680 plane. The locked tail element is `target30`
   [1,30,30] BOOL = 900 (the #48 overlay condition). **CORRECTION (W5):** the earlier
   "U32 unpack 1,680 is forced" line over-priced the bit-test by assuming the integer dtype
   must survive into the per-cell plane — it need not; dtype-narrow before the per-cell expand.
   None of this affects the sub-3k lower bound.
3. **Detection > 0, and the full 3-step reach is forced BY VISIBLE alone (measured
   2026-06-06).** The reach-ablation ladder — the natural "cheaper structural rung in the
   LIVE noise-band" play the task's own ship history suggests — fails the visible gate
   before hidden risk is even reached: 2 steps of +-2 (distance 4) = **258/266**; 2 steps
   of +-3 (full distance but gap-2/3 bridging) = **217/266**; 1x2 = 170/266; 1x3 = 194/266.
   Officials contain distance-5/6 witnesses AND gap-2/3 box pairs, so every cut is a
   certain hidden 0 (§VISIBLE-FAIL). Even granting a magical ONE-plane paint operator
   (none exists), the bound is 2,100 + 420 + 1,320 + params ≈ **3,876**. The real minimum
   with a CORRECT detection family is now the packed-row candidate's **7,161**
   (previous v1: 7,235; alternates: pos-trick +1,260;
   closing corpus-dead; bitboard ~8.4k; imos-corners ~9.3k; vertical-mirror unsound;
   2-channel QLinearConv stacks scale at 420/channel).
4. **The sub-3k club is structurally different.** task268 (3,701) is a 10x10 task —
   quarter-size planes; task055 (1,174) is rank-1 separable (no plane ever exists);
   task215 (110) / task252 (280) are plane-free or params-only rules; task213 (2,193)
   is tiny stride-gather structure. task077 is a 20x21, inherently-2D, multi-component
   per-cell rule — it is not in that club and cannot be put there.
5. **The only known sub-3k graphs that pass visible on THIS task are lookup/memorization**
   (lookup8 10,802 / binary-probe 9,945 / lookup_sched 14,592→~10k DP) — all documented
   hidden-bad here (0/100 generic synth; the family carries Kaggle receipts: -13 LB class
   regressions and the 7-member zero-public-weight roster). Re-probing it buys no new
   information for a slot.

Verdict: **6,503 is the current constructive floor (v5 param-shave + 7/7/7 shared-mask unpack, 2026-07-11);
~3,876 is the absolute information-flow bound no correct graph can beat; <3,000 is unreachable without
scoring-rule exploits that are all patched (multi-output/symbolic/sparse → None) or priced (dynamic classes
converge to true-trace cost, §39).** Memory 6,424 is at representation floor — reach 2,160 (col-packing
≥2,544: 21>20 words), unpack 1,540 (3-lane optimal; 7/7/7 == 8/8/5 on memory), Pad 900 (#48 locked);
every flood block verified-needed (single ablation → 265/266). The remaining lever below 6,513 is
**params** (credited cost = memory + Σmath.prod(init.dims)): Boladi deduped identical inits (6,524→6,513,
−11); v5 removes shift2/zero_u32/zero_u8 byte-identically (−3) and consolidates the unpack masks via the

  distribution (gaps >=2 in the separating axis; sandwiching boxes 1 row apart impossible).

  min-reductions at grid borders (0 < INF wins) — any windowed-min propagation needs
  neutral-element fills (shift_fill). Symptom: cluster bboxes snapping to row/col 0.

  the cross-box aliasing the ±6/±2 hull died of (170/266) — the >=2-gap geometry only
  protects steps <=2.

  the free-input pack + `Xor(m,p)` is the cheaper route; do NOT reuse 8.4k as a floor). v1

  converged V5j flood 200000/200000; **2-step reach fails 4,300/200,000 on the generator

  strengthens floor-proof #3); dropping V5j-fill OR between-v each = 265/266 officials.
  Full prose in `_archive/task077_history.md`.

  fused `V5+J` as `MaxPool[5,3]` scored 6,812 but 0/266 visible; horizontal
  `MaxPool[1,3]` in place of J-fill scored 7,232 but 0/266; vertical `MaxPool[3,1]`

- 2026-06-22 (Worker-10, exit-fuse probe) — **PARTIALLY SUPERSEDED 2026-06-24 (W5).** Worker-10 tried to FUSE the U32 packed-word → Where-condition exit and found no op bypasses a [1,20,21]-shaped intermediate; its priced alternatives (Pad U32 first 2,520; Cast U32→F32 + Div/Floor/Mod 2×1,680; 21× BitShift+AND) all stayed in U32 / kept a 4 B/cell plane. The conclusion "the 1,680 B BitwiseAnd cannot be skipped" was **wrong as a floor**: the bit-test does not need the integer dtype to survive into the per-cell plane. **W5 fix (cost 6,524, all gates pass):** dtype-NARROW the word into 3 UINT8 lanes (bits 0-7/8-15/16-20) BEFORE the per-cell expand, AND each lane vs an 8/8/5-wide U8 pow-mask, Greater→BOOL, Concat axis=2 → [1,20,21] BOOL. Unpack plane 1,680 (U32) → 420 (Concat BOOL) + 420 (sub-AND U8) + 420 (Greater BOOL) + 300 (lanes); net −637. `staged_submits/task077_v3_u8lane_unpack_cost6524/`. **New floor = 6,524**; the locked tail element is now `target30` [1,30,30] BOOL = 900 (the #48 overlay condition). Lesson: when a "forced" charged plane is an integer bit-expand, check whether the same bits fit in a 1-byte dtype (U8/BOOL) — the per-cell expand should run in the SMALLEST dtype that holds the value, not the dtype of the packed word.
